title: GhostCart Finch API: error response (HTTP 401, 422, 429, 502, 503, 504, 500)
description: 401 missing/wrong token; 422 invalid input or no fashion items in the photo; 429 too many Finch requests at once; 502 product search failed; 503 not configured or product search rate-limited (see Retry-After); 504 timed out.
